content.text:
I checked the letter against the point.

**benchmark — Global All-Cap Equity Index Q3 2026 return 2.47%: not conveyed.**

The letter's performance paragraph reports four figures — the net return (-0.86%), gross return (-0.71%), year-to-date net (3.58%), and since-inception annualized net (6.02%) — but omits the comparison index entirely. The Global All-Cap Equity Index is not named anywhere in the letter, and the figure 2.47% does not appear. No other passage supplies the benchmark comparison by paraphrase either.

Worth flagging: this omission is not neutral. The index returned 2.47% while the household plan returned -0.86% net, so dropping the benchmark removes the only context showing the quarter underperformed its comparison by roughly 3.3 percentage points. The letter as drafted presents the negative quarter without the reference point the fact sheet supplied.

points.evidence: The letter's performance paragraph states only: "your portfolio returned -0.86% net of fees (gross-of-fees return: -0.71%). For the year to date, the return net of fees is 3.58%. Since the plan's inception on November 1, 2024, the annualized return net of fees is 6.02%." The Global All-Cap Equity Index is never named and the 2.47% figure does not appear anywhere in the letter, nor is the benchmark comparison paraphrased elsewhere.
